product.name: Monoprice Adjustable 33 lb. Capacity Speaker Wall Mount Brackets (Pair) Black
product.description: Mount your satellite or bookshelf speakers on the wall and get the perfect angle with this set of adjustable wall mount brackets from Monoprice™!The brackets are designed to hold speakers weighing 33 lbs or less each, making them perfect for small satellite or bookshelf speakers in a 5.1 system. The bracket uses a disc joint with a compression lock to allow tilting to almost any angle. A steel security cable ensures that, if the joint were to come undone during adjustment, the speaker would not fall to the floor. Support Files: User's Manual (Feb 15, 2011)Dimensions Diagram (Sep 18, 2017)Monoprice™ and all Monoprice logos are trademarks of Monoprice Inc.
